en: A black and white vintage postcard featuring a garden scene with a pergola pathway, covered in climbing plants and greenery. There is a clear inscription at the bottom left and right, which labels the location as Bad Pyrmont and specifies the Palmengarten (Palm Garden) along the Fürstenweg. The back of the postcard is blank except for printed lines, a mark from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', and the name 'Carl Maltzahn, Bad Pyrmont' as publisher.
